title: The Preakness at the Beach | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: The Preakness at the Beach - Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool & Rooftop DeckFavorite Features:- Gulf Views
description_expanded: The Preakness at the Beach - Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool & Rooftop Deck Favorite Features: - Gulf Views - Private Pool - Pool Heat $75/Night (Available Oct-April Only) - Elevator - 4 Bikes Included - 2 Sets of Backpack Beach Chairs More about The Preakness at the Beach: Preakness at the Beach is a luxurious beach house in Dune Allen along 30A, where coastal elegance meets unparalleled comfort. This exquisite beach house is designed for large groups, offering opulent amenities and stunning features to ensure an unforgettable stay. Sleeping up to 14 guests across five king suites and a bunk room, this house is meant for multi-family vacations, large celebrations, reunions, and retreats! Guests will enjoy a private pool, a state-of-the-art kitchen, a rooftop terrace, and only a three-minute walk from the beach. Bring your family and furry friends to the winner's circle and find your slice of paradise at The Preakness at the Beach.  Step into the grandeur of dual living rooms, each meticulously decorated with high-end furnishings and adorned with tasteful coastal decor. These spaces provide both elegance and comfort, creating inviting atmospheres for gatherings or moments of quiet relaxation. The first living room seamlessly opens to a private pool, creating a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living. Lounge in style on plush furnishings by the pool or indulge in outdoor culinary delights at the fully-equipped kitchen, complete with a grill, sink, and ample counter space. The main kitchen, a focal point of luxury, boasts a Viking appliance suite. This state-of-the-art suite includes a double fridge/freezer, eight eight-burner gas stove, double oven, dual dishwashers, and a beverage cooler. Immerse yourself in culinary creativity as you prepare gourmet meals in this chef's dream kitchen. Premium countertops, top-of-the-line appliances, and an expansive layout create an inspiring space for both cooking and socializing. Ascend a spiral staircase to the rooftop terrace, a crowning jewel of this beach house. Enjoy panoramic views of the Gulf and the surrounding area from this elevated vantage point. With ample space, this terrace becomes a prime spot for sunset gatherings, stargazing, or simply unwinding with a refreshing drink. A defining feature of this beach house is the presence of a private elevator, seamlessly integrated into the design. This elevator offers effortless access to all living levels of the residence (does not access the rooftop terrace,) ensuring that every corner of this multi-story home is easily reachable, enhancing accessibility and convenience for all residents and guests. The beach house features five king suites, each exuding luxury with lavish furnishings, high-quality linens, and thoughtfully curated decor. Additionally, a bunk room accommodates large groups or families, providing a playful and comfortable space for younger guests. This luxurious beach house in Dune Allen on 30A is more than a residence; it's a destination where every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide an indulgent coastal experience. From the private pool and outdoor kitchen to the Viking-equipped kitchen, dual living rooms, and rooftop terrace, this beach house offers a haven of opulence for large groups seeking the pinnacle of beachfront living. Sleeping Arrangements: SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed with Patio Access & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: King Bed with Patio Access & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. FOURTH FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 4: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 5: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
